import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, V, x):
        V = frozenset(V)
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
        dim_0 = x.shape[0]
        assert x.shape == (dim_0,)

        self.V = V
        self.x = x
        # z = 1
        self.z = 1

    def f(self, S):
        S = frozenset(S)
        fset_0 = set()
        set_range = S
        for i in set_range:
            fset_0.add(self.x[i-1])
        return min(fset_0)

    def g(self, S):
        S = frozenset(S)
        gset_0 = set()
        set_range_1 = S
        for i in set_range_1:
            gset_0.add(self.x[i-1])
        return max(gset_0)
